key_impacts: Reactor plants at Fukushima Daiichi were damaged, necessitating a long-term decommissioning roadmap for Units 1–4.
Large volumes of ALPS-treated contaminated water stored on-site (~1.1 million m³ as of October 2018).
Fuel debris remains in Units 1–3, with internal PCV investigations ongoing.
